name: canonical-ledger-wallet-convergence
objective: Make the double-entry ledger the only authoritative balance mutation path and convert legacy wallet/ledger stores to derived/historical projections.
truthOwner: WLT canonical ledger transactions/lines/accounts own accounting truth.

tasks.objective: Eliminate active direct monetary mutation outside one canonical projection mechanism.
tasks.currentProblem: Canonical double-entry, legacy ledger entries and direct wlt_wallets balance updates coexist.
tasks.requiredChange: Inventory every active writer, route all effects through canonical postings and make wallet materialization projection-only with explicit reconciliation/backfill.
tasks.targetState: One authoritative accounting path and a projection exactly derived from it.
mustNotChange: Do not delete historical rows without migration evidence.
Do not hide drift with fallback reads.
acceptanceCriteria: Active direct legacy balance writer count outside projection is zero.
tasks.rollback: Preserve legacy history read-only; rollback code must not restore legacy authority.

tasks.objective: Canonicalize penalty post/reverse with trusted context, one ledger effect and complete audit/replay/concurrency controls.
tasks.currentProblem: Penalty posts canonical ledger and separately mutates wallet; request boundary accepts operator context input.
tasks.requiredChange: Use trusted middleware/server context, one idempotent canonical posting and projection/readback from ledger truth.
tasks.targetState: Penalty/reversal cannot double-affect balances or cross contexts.
mustNotChange: Do not accept caller-selected financial scope.
Do not bypass canonical ledger for performance.
Do not mutate completed history in place.
acceptanceCriteria: Caller header/payload cannot choose financial scope.
Post/reverse each create one canonical effect.
tasks.rollback: Reverse through governed ledger correction, never raw wallet update.

tasks.objective: Move representative wallet/ledger read APIs and financial controls off legacy ledger-entry authority onto canonical account/transaction read models.
tasks.currentProblem: Compatibility ledger entries can still feed current reads/close and diverge from canonical postings.
tasks.requiredChange: Build canonical scoped read models and explicit projection-consistency checks.
tasks.targetState: All current balance/ledger readback comes from canonical accounting/projection truth.
mustNotChange: Do not mix canonical and legacy rows into a silent aggregate.
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy-only rows cannot change current balance/close.
tasks.rollback: Keep compatibility history query separately labeled, never as current balance authority.
